title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing: Class Acceptance Schedule for Vehicles
content:
A vehicle is accepted into a Keyturn Vehicle Listing class only on the value band, age limit, odometer limit and seat range that class publishes, and on the titling and registration the class will take. The schedule below is the whole of that basis, class by class.

| Class | Lowest vehicle value accepted (USD) | Highest vehicle value accepted (USD) | Oldest vehicle, whole years from model year | Highest odometer accepted (miles) | Fewest seat belts | Most seat belts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 3000.00 | 18000.00 | 14 | 150000 | 4 | 5 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 18000.01 | 38000.00 | 12 | 130000 | 4 | 7 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 38000.01 | 72000.00 | 9 | 100000 | 2 | 7 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 72000.01 | 160000.00 | 7 | 80000 | 2 | 7 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 160000.01 | 400000.00 | 6 | 40000 | 2 | 4 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 12000.00 | 120000.00 | 10 | 175000 | 2 | 15 |

### Titling, lender consent, registration and plates

| Class | Title standings the class will list | Written lender consent needed on a financed vehicle | Registration from outside the home market | Commercially plated vehicle |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | outright ownership, or ownership financed with a lender named on the title | required | not accepted | not accepted |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | outright ownership, or ownership financed with a lender named on the title | required | accepted | not accepted |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | outright ownership, ownership financed with a lender named on the title, or a lease | required | accepted | not accepted |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | outright ownership, or a lease | required | accepted | not accepted |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | outright ownership only | required | not accepted | not accepted |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | outright ownership, ownership financed with a lender named on the title, or a lease | required | accepted | accepted |

Read across a single row and the acceptance basis for that class is complete: a vehicle valued at 25000.00 USD, eleven years old on its model year, showing 96000 miles and carrying five seat belts sits inside every figure the Keyturn Standard Class Listing row publishes, while the same vehicle is outside the value band the Keyturn Economy Class Listing row publishes, whose highest accepted value is 18000.00 USD. Every figure above is a boundary the class accepts at, not a figure it accepts short of.
